post.meta_description: راهنمای انتخاب و نصب نوار تیp ۲۰ سانتی‌متری برای آبیاری سیb‌زمینی; نکات فنی, چک‌لیست پیش از سفارش و پرسش‌های متداول.
post.html:
سیب‌زمینی یکی از محصولات زراعی مهم است que آبیاری دقیق و منظم آن نقش بسzardayi dar amalkard va keyfiyat mahsool nahayi darad. Nabar tip ba fasele qatre-chakan 20 santi-metr gozine-i amali baraye kasht-e radifi in mahsool hisab mishavad. Dar in maghale, tamarkoz bar usul-e fani entekhab, nasb va negahdari nabar tip moteneseb ba niaz-haye abiyari sib-zamini ast va be barresi nokat-e mohemi mipardazim ke pish az kharid va rah-andazi sistem bayad mad-e Nazar gharaer girad. Baraye motale'e va kharid خرید نوار تیپ ۲۰ سانتی در کاج mitavanid eghdam namayid.

Shenakht-e sakhtar va karbard-haye nabar tip 20 santi-metri dar kasht-e sib-zamini

Nabar tip no'-i loole abiyari ast ke qatre-chakan-haye an ba fasele-haye mosakhhas ruye badne gharar darand. Dar model 20 santi-metri, fasele markaz har qatre-chakan ta markaz qatre-chakan ba'di daghighan 20 santi-metr ast. In fasele baraye kasht-haye radifi ba tarakkom-e buhte-i bala, az jomle sib-zamini, munasibtar ast zira ab ra dar mohite rize-rashi har buhte be-soorat-e yeknavakht tawzi' mikunad.

Janis-e rayej in navar-ha az poly-ethylene sakhte mishavad, ama pish az entekhab hatman barghe fanni mahsool ra barresi konid; zir-gahi jadarah va moghavemat dar barabar-e ashe-e UV batife model nabar motafavtot ast va faghat ba moraje'e be barghe fanni mitavan az entebagh an ba sharayet-e mazra'e otmin hasal kard.

Be-va-sonbat, dar mazare'-e sib-zamini ba'-zi menatigh-e sard-sir-e arupa ke fasele-haye kasht-e barik-tari darand, az nabar tip 20 santi-metri estefade mishavad. Alboode in adad ghabel-e ta'mim-e ghata'i be hame sharayet nist va bayad bar asas-e dade-haye tarhizi mazra'e va tavsie mote-khases entekhab gardad.

Arzyabi niaz-e kasht-e sib-zamini va sharayet-e mazra'e

Pish az kharid tadzimat abiyari, shenakht-e daghigh sharayet-e mazra'e zaruri ast. Baft-e khak, shib-e zamin va amagh nazd-e rize sib-zamini az jumle amil-hayi hastan ke bar entekhab-e fasele qatre-chakan va tool-e khat nabar tasir migzarand. Agar fasele kasht-e radifi sib-zamini be-guneh-i ast ke har buhte niaz be taghziye ab-i mostaghel darad, nabar tip ba fasele 20 santi-metr entekhab-e mantighi-tari khahad bud.

Dar mazare'-e shib-dar, oft-e feshar bayn-e ebteva va entabaye nabar mitavanad bahes tawzi'-e nahamgun ab shamad; dar-navam hesab-e daghigh feshar-e kari va tool-e har khat nabar ahmiiyat vizeh-i darad. Tavsie fasele qatre-chakan va deb-e mehruj baraye sib-zamini bedune dade tarhizi va moshavaret ba mote-khases ghabel-e ta'yin ba adad-e sabet nist. Hamchenin keyfiyat ab-e vorudi, be-visse mijzad zarrat-e mo'alleg, bar entekhab-e no'-e filtr asar-e mostaghim darad.

Osul-e nasb va entekhab-e etesalat

Nasb-e sahieh nabar tip nasb-e sahieh nabar tip naqsh-e mohem-i dar amalkard-e yeknavakht sistem abiyari darad. Nabar bayad ruye sarhate saf va bedune takhordag-i-haye shadid panah shavad; khim-budigi-haye nagahani mitavanand bahes ka-hosh debi ya asab mekaniki be loole shavan. Obur mashin alat-e keshavarzi ruye nabar nasb-shode akidan tavsie nemishavad.

Ettesalat bayn nabar tip va loole asli bayad ba daghigh va bedune neshti anjam girand. Pishnahad mishavad avvalen sistem ra ba feshar kam test konid, neshti-ha ra shenasaee va raf'-e namayid va sip feshar ra tadrijan be halat-e adde brasanid. Sabt-e ettela-at nasb shamol no'-e nabar, feshar-e kari va tarikh nasb baraye peygiri-haye ba'di mofid ast. Baraye agahi bishtar darore digar tadzimat راهنمای تجهیزات آبیاری در شهرکرد ra mutale'a farmayid.

Naghsh-e filtrasiyun va negahdari sistem

Enosadat qatre-chakan-ha shay-e-tarin chalash dar estefade az nabar tip ba fasele riz ast. Masir-e dakhili in navar-ha barik boode va zarrat-e riz mo-alleq dar ab mitavanand be-soorat musadud shavan. Nasb sistem filtrasiyun munasib pish az vorud ab be nabar tip elzam i ast. No'-e filtr batife keyfiyat manba-e ab taysin mishavad.

Harkoone shost-o-shu ki miyaee ya asidi bayad sarfan pas az barresi keyfiyat ab va ba nazar-e mote-khases anjam pa-zeer shavad. Sabt-e zaman abiyari, payesh-e rotubat khak va mostanad-sazi taghyirat mazra'e be islah barname abiyari komak shayani mikonad. Baraye ettela-at behtar darore majmoe آبگستر فرا پارسیان mitavanid eghdam namayid.

Chak-list pish az sofrish va nasb nabar tip

  • Barresi barghe fanni nabar tip az nazar zir-gahi jadarah va moghavamat UV
  • Tatbiq fasele kasht sib-zamini ba fasele qatre-chakan 20 santi-metri
  • Arzyabi keyfiyat ab va entekhab no'-e filtr moteneseb
  • Sanjash shib zamin va hesab oft feshar ehtemali dar tool khat nabar
  • Tahie ettesalat standard va malzomat lazem
  • Test sistem ba feshar pa-ien pish az rah-andazi nihayi
  • Sabt ettela-at nasb shamol no'-e nabar, feshar kari va tarikh ejra

Porsesh-haye motalav

Aya fasele 20 santi-metri baraye hame mazare-sib-zamini munasib ast?

Khayr. Fasele qatre-chakan bayad bar asas-e fasele kasht radifi va tarakkom buhte-i taysin shavad. Tavsie fasele va deb mahsool sib-zamini bedune dade tarhiz adad sabti nadarad va moshavaret ba mote-khases tavsie mishavad.

Aya mitavan az nabar tip 20 santi-metri baraye saer mahsoolat radifi estefade kard?

Bale, nabar tip baraye kasht-haye radifi ba fasele kasht barik ghabel estefade ast, ama entekhab nihayi bayad bar asas sharayet mazra'e va tavsie kardan sasorat girad.

Naghsh filtr dar amalkard nabar tip chi ast?

Filtr az vorud zarrat mo-alleq va rasubath be dakhil masir barik nabar jalon migirad. Bedune filtrasiyun munasib, khatr enosadat qatre-chakan-ha afzayesh yafte va amalkard yeknavakht abiyarimokhtil mishavad. No'-e filtr bayad bar asas keyfiyat ab entekhab gardad.
